decision.risk_assessment: BTC and ETH are displaying strong bullish momentum (ADX 36.5), but both assets are severely overbought on the 1h timeframe (RSI 88.6 for BTC, 83.8 for ETH) and trading above upper Bollinger Bands near 7d highs. High risk of short-term pullback towards dynamic support (EMA 9/21).
decision.reasoning: While trend-following indicators remain strong, entering long positions at current resistance levels with extreme overbought RSI values presents poor risk/reward. Waiting for a consolidation or minor pullback to test EMA support levels prior to entering long positions.
